verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents per-consumer authentication (AI Auth Strategy attached to AI Agent entities), an AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin for enforcing request/token limits, and accurate per-request cost calculation explicitly tied to 'budget enforcement, per-consumer spend limits, and chargeback' — covering the core building blocks for giving an agent its own key with spend/rate guardrails. However, docs describe budget enforcement only as a downstream capability enabled by cost data rather than showing a concrete dollar-budget-cap configuration workflow, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can be hard-capped from overspending. Missing for 10: a concrete documented budget-cap (not just rate-limit) configuration example, and independent verification of runaway-spend prevention in practice.
